description_expanded: AboutThe Pearl on Woodland | Luxury 30A Vacation Rental in Santa Rosa Beach with Private Pool, Outdoor Kitchen, and Golf Cart Included Why Guests Love This Property: • Prime location on Scenic Highway 30A in Santa Rosa Beach • Large private resort-style pool with expansive pool deck • Six-seater street legal golf cart included • Outdoor kitchen with grill and Green Egg for elevated outdoor cooking • Two spacious living rooms ideal for families and multi-generational groups; 2nd floor living room has sleeper sofa • Stunning two-way fireplace overlooking the pool deck • Fully stocked gourmet kitchen with high-end appliances and spices • Three king bedrooms, two with private ensuite bathrooms • Super fun triple bunk space plus twin-over-twin bunk room for kids and teens • Sleeps up to 13 guests comfortably • Multiple poolside decks with lounge seating and outdoor dining • Coastal luxury décor and high-end designer finishes throughout • Large walk-in pantry for extended stays and group storage • Bicycles for exploring Scenic 30A • Backpack beach chairs and beach umbrella provided • Pool toys, cornhole game, and family-friendly entertainment • Children’s dishes, kids toys, books for adults and children • Dedicated desk workspace for remote work • Full-size washer and dryer in separate laundry room • Enjoy starter amenities, Starbucks coffee, and bottles of water A Coastal Luxury Retreat on 30A Welcome to The Pearl on Woodland, a stunning luxury 30A vacation rental located in the heart of Santa Rosa Beach. Designed with elevated coastal style and high-end finishes throughout, this two-story retreat offers the perfect blend of comfort, elegance, and resort-style outdoor living. From the moment you arrive, you will notice the attention to detail — from designer furnishings and curated décor to expansive gathering spaces designed for connection and relaxation. Whether you are planning a family vacation, a couples getaway, or a multi-generational retreat, this 30A luxury rental delivers an unforgettable beach experience. Resort-Style Outdoor Living Outdoor living is where The Pearl on Woodland truly shines. The very large private pool serves as the centerpiece of the home, surrounded by generous lounge seating, shaded areas, and multiple decks overlooking the pool. Guests enjoy: • Expansive private pool with ample seating • Outdoor kitchen with grill and Green Egg • Outdoor dining space perfect for family dinners • Two elevated decks overlooking the pool • Cornhole game and pool toys for added fun • Six-seater street legal golf cart included Whether you are grilling fresh Gulf seafood, relaxing poolside with a book, or enjoying sunset cocktails from one of the decks, this home was designed for effortless coastal entertaining. Open Concept Coastal Luxury Living Step inside to discover a bright open-concept main living area featuring coastal luxury design and high-end finishes. The main living room showcases a stunning two-way fireplace that overlooks the pool deck, creating a seamless indoor and outdoor atmosphere. A second living room provides additional space for guests to spread out, making this home ideal for larger groups. The fully stocked gourmet kitchen includes: • High-end appliances • Large walk-in pantry • Generous counter space • Spices and cooking essentials • Quality cookware and serveware Whether preparing a family feast or hosting a casual breakfast before the beach, this kitchen is designed to impress. Thoughtfully Designed Sleeping Spaces The Pearl on Woodland comfortably sleeps up to 13 guests with flexible accommodations for both adults and children. Bedroom layout includes: • Three king bedrooms, two with private ensuite bathrooms • Twin-over-twin bunk bedroom • Super fun triple bunk space perfect for kids or teens • Three full bathrooms and one half bath Each bedroom is beautifully appointed with high-end décor, comfortable bedding, and thoughtful touches that make guests feel at home. Family-Friendly Amenities and Extras This Santa Rosa Beach vacation rental is equipped with everything needed for a stress-free stay: • Bicycles for exploring Scenic Highway 30A • Backpack beach chairs and beach umbrella • Pool toys and outdoor games • Books for adults and children • Kids toys and children’s dishware • Dedicated desk workspace • Full-size washer and dryer Every detail has been considered to make traveling with family easy and enjoyable. Prime 30A Location in Santa Rosa Beach Located along Scenic Highway 30A in Santa Rosa Beach, The Pearl on Woodland places you close to some of the most sought-after destinations on the Emerald Coast. Enjoy nearby beach access, Gulf Place, Shunk Gulley's, boutique shopping, local dining, and scenic bike paths that define the 30A lifestyle. Cruise to the beach in the golf cart, explore neighboring beach communities, or spend the day lounging by your private pool — the choice is yours. Your Elevated 30A Escape Awaits With its large private pool, outdoor kitchen, two spacious living rooms, gourmet chef’s kitchen, luxury finishes, and prime Santa Rosa Beach location, The Pearl on Woodland stands out as a premier luxury 30A vacation rental. Whether you are gathering around the fireplace, grilling poolside, biking along 30A, or relaxing under the Florida sun, this home offers the space, style, and setting for unforgettable coastal memories. Book your stay at The Pearl on Woodland and experience elevated luxury living on Scenic Highway 30A.
